name: unframed
description: A tiny local node-based image generator (GPT Image 2 via OpenRouter).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: node client/src/graph/resolve.test.js && node server/env.test.js && node server/share.test.js && node server/presets.test.js
